evals.name: fork-merge
evals.prompt: We have two validation forms - ACI_Culinary_Validation_Form_MASTER_v1_3_BLANK.docx and MVC_Validation_Form_MASTER_v1_0_BLANK (1).docx, both in C:\Users\daman\Downloads. I want one form both brands can use, with room for a third brand. Tell me exactly what differs between them and what you would change.
evals.expected_output: A diff-first analysis finding the documents are textually identical apart from the register prefix, and a plan to parameterise the brand rather than rebuild.
assertions: Diffs the two documents before proposing any merge approach
Reports that the two forms are textually identical apart from the register prefix
Does NOT propose rebuilding the form from scratch
Proposes driving the brand from document properties rather than hard-coded text
Identifies BT- and GW- as legal-entity prefixes that should be retired in favour of brand prefixes
Normalises character encoding before diffing, or otherwise avoids false differences from numeric character references

evals.name: register-contradiction
evals.prompt: Our steps document and the pre-assessment master prompt seem to disagree about how many rows go into the continuous improvement register for one validation. The files are ACI_MVC_Validation_to_Closure_Steps_v1_0.docx and MVC_Pre-Assessment_Validation_MASTER_PROMPT.docx in C:\Users\daman\Downloads. Work out which is right and what should happen.
evals.expected_output: Both conflicting statements quoted, the master prompt identified as governing, settled on one entry per unit, and the losing document flagged for amendment.
assertions: Quotes or cites both conflicting statements from the two documents
Resolves the conflict in favour of one register entry per unit
Identifies which document governs rather than picking arbitrarily
States that the losing document must be amended, not just noted
Mentions that the detail stays in the validation form at B.9-B.11 or C.6-C.8

evals.name: risk-rescore
evals.prompt: MSF30322 Certificate III in Cabinet Making is staying on our scope but we are not delivering it - there is no cohort. What does that mean for the Assessment Validation Plan? The file is Assessment_Validation_Plan_v2_0.docx in C:\Users\daman\Downloads.
evals.expected_output: A rescore using the plan's six-factor risk model dropping the product from High to Medium, with sample size adjusted and the Part B / Part C consequence stated.
assertions: Applies the plan's six-factor weighted risk model rather than asserting a rating
Sets delivery status to 0 and cohort vulnerability to 0 because there is no cohort
Arrives at a Medium rating (total around 16), not High
Adjusts the sample size to the Medium band
States that Part B still applies before any tool is issued
States that Part C cannot run until a first cohort has been assessed
Does NOT remove the product from the plan, since it remains on scope
